name: design-review-rules
description: Rule sets for an independent design reviewer: review passes, slop tells and an accessibility and interface floor.

upstreams.name: gstack
upstreams.licence: MIT (gstack, refero_skill); Apache-2.0 (impeccable, OpenDesign, Anthropic) notices

skills.name: design-review-passes
skills.description: Review passes for rendered or planned UI: name the surface mode (persuade, operate, read, experience), then information architecture, state coverage, journey, AI-slop risk, design-system alignment, responsive and accessibility, unresolved decisions, plus the trunk test and audit categories. Use when reviewing someone else's design work from screenshots or a plan.

skills.name: slop-tells
skills.description: Visual tells of generated, default-looking UI (indigo accents, trust gradients, emoji icons, template chrome, overused faces, card soup), with ids and severities. Use when reviewing screenshots or a plan for AI-slop and template defaults; DESIGN.md and the brief win over any tell.

skills.name: a11y-floor
skills.description: Accessibility and interface floor for reviewing UI: contrast, touch targets, focus visibility, labels, keyboard and semantic structure, ARIA, reduced motion, forms, typography, content handling, dark mode and i18n rules. Use when reviewing screenshots, a preview or a plan for accessibility and interface defects.
